visualCharacteristics.purpose: Stat callout: a short statement paragraph beside a graphic that shows the statistic (e.g. '10x' tolerance image)
visualCharacteristics.layout: Two columns vertically centered on desktop, text left, graphic right; stacked on mobile

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 statement paragraph; cell 2 stat image, optionally wrapped in a link (e.g. to a PDF article)

usage: Single highlighted statistic with supporting text.
reuseGuidance: Use for text plus a stat graphic. Keep the stat value in the image alt text, not in a heading.
